SHIFT PAY RULES
- Base rate: CZK 769.55 per hour.
- Breaks: a shift longer than 5 hours includes an unpaid break of 45 minutes; shorter shifts have no unpaid break.

- Weekly overtime: regular (not daily-overtime) hours above 40 in the week earn an extra 0.5x the base rate; hours already paid as daily overtime are not counted again.
- Night premium: a shift that starts at 22:00 or later earns CZK 26.12 extra per paid hour (never multiplied by an overtime factor).
- Only the final gross pay is rounded, to the cent.

- Weekly overtime: hours above 40 in the week are paid at 1.25x the base rate.
- Only the final gross pay is rounded, to the cent.

FORTNIGHTLY PAY RULES
- Base rate: CHF 15.87 per hour.
- Overtime: in EACH calendar week separately, hours above 38 are paid at 1.75x the base rate. The two weeks are never added together for this rule.
- Evening differential: 15% of the base rate for every evening hour, on top of the pay for that hour; the differential is never multiplied by the overtime factor.
- Only the final gross pay is rounded, to the cent.
